intro: Lesson 59: Coastal ecosystems and the threats they face (2.2). Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Exam practice: (a) Describe the distribution of coral reefs. (3) (b) Explain how mangroves are adapted to coastal conditions. (4) (c) Assess the threats to one coastal ecosystem. (8)
questions.a: (a) tropics, between about 30 N and 30 S, east coasts of continents, shallow seas (b) prop roots, salt excretion, breathing roots (c) balanced assessment of human and natural threats with judgement
questions.model: Teacher plans (c): intro, human threats, natural and climate threats, judgement.

questions.q: Explain how salt marshes help protect the land behind them.
questions.a: Vegetation and mud absorb wave energy (1) and store flood water (1)

questions.q: Explain why mangroves are valuable to coastal people.
questions.a: Roots absorb wave energy, reducing storm surge and erosion (2); nurseries for fish provide food and income; timber and honey (2)
questions.model: Value 1: protection from storms. How: roots slow waves. Value 2: food and jobs. How: fish breed among roots.
